$comment: Authored native status for the v1.1.0 event catalog, applied by tools/SurfaceInventory/build-event-catalog.mjs --overlay. Assessed against PiSharp sources at b831158a9379e8a7f454a069ee18551c90bd7eac (with the 1.1.0.3 close-out cases in tests/PiSharp.ExtensionParity.Tests/CloseoutCases.cs). All 41 events carry native evidence. Node extensions register through PiNodeOwner in the same ExtensionRegistry as native C# extensions, so host dispatch reaches both; Node-backed cases need Node.js. Tests are authored and registered, not executed by the refresh.

nativeProfile.actualExecution: Typed reducers and observations are registered through IExtensionRegistry and bound into the agent/session host; see each event nativeEvidence. Authored tests are cited, not executed by this refresh.

statusVocabulary.ImplementedWithAuthoredTests: Native registration and host emission exist and an authored, registered test case exercises them.
statusVocabulary.PartialRegistryTestOnly: Host emission exists; only registry-level behavior is tested.
statusVocabulary.EmittedTestsNotRegistered: Host emission exists; the authored tests are not run by any test Program.cs.
statusVocabulary.WireOnlyNotDispatchedToExtensions: The event exists on RPC/JSON output only; native extension handlers do not receive it.
